aggregation_semantics.aulc: Normalized trapezoidal integral of fold-mean MAE at fractions 0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0, divided by 0.9.
aggregation_semantics.disagreement: Full-train predictions paired by task, feature, fold, repeat, and material ID; high disagreement is >= the per-task/feature 0.75 quantile.
aggregation_semantics.high_target_change: Signed (structure - composition) / composition * 100 at full train.
aggregation_semantics.learning_curve_mae: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the five official-fold MAEs.
aggregation_semantics.target_regime_mae: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the five fold-level regime MAEs.
aggregation_semantics.target_regimes: Three pd.qcut target bins computed separately within each official test fold.
